_comment: https://github.com/rolldown/rolldown/issues/10048 - with `experimental.lazyBarrel` + `strictExecutionOrder`, theming.js imports helper-only bindings (`__commonJS` / `__toESM`) and calls them at the top level, while also indirectly re-exporting `themes` from data.js. Using that indirect re-export retains theming's body, so its helper dependencies must remain reachable as well. Executing the compiled entry via `_test.mjs` must not throw.
